title: DSM-5-TR Substance Use Disorder Criteria
instructions: Documentation aid for DSM-5-TR substance use disorder criteria in the past 12 months.

score.missing_response_policy: unchecked criteria score 0; tolerance and withdrawal should not be counted when DSM-5-TR excludes them for a substance

items.text: Substance is often taken in larger amounts or over a longer period than was intended.
items.short_text: Used in larger amounts/longer than intended

items.text: Persistent desire or unsuccessful efforts to cut down or control substance use.
items.short_text: Persistent desire or unsuccessful efforts to cut down

items.text: A great deal of time is spent in activities necessary to obtain, use, or recover from the substance.
Craving, or a strong desire or urge to use the substance.
Recurrent substance use resulting in a failure to fulfill major role obligations at work, school, or home.
items.short_text: Role failure at work, school, or home

items.text: Continued substance use despite persistent or recurrent social or interpersonal problems caused or exacerbated by use.
Important social, occupational, or recreational activities are given up or reduced because of use.
items.short_text: Important activities given up or reduced

items.text: Recurrent substance use in situations in which it is physically hazardous.
items.short_text: Recurrent use in physically hazardous situations

items.text: Use continues despite knowledge of a persistent or recurrent physical or psychological problem likely caused or exacerbated by the substance.
items.short_text: Continued use despite physical or psychological problem

severity_bands.label: NO SUD
severity_bands.action: Does not meet threshold for SUD diagnosis; fewer than 2 criteria.

report.heading: DSM-5-TR Substance Use Disorder Assessment
report.scoring_note: Scoring: 2-3 criteria = mild, 4-5 criteria = moderate, 6 or more criteria = severe.
report.screening_note: Withdrawal is not counted for hallucinogens, phencyclidine, or inhalants in this documentation aid.
